use default
use Raster.COLOUR_MAP
use Raster.IMAGE

use Step = (x: double, y: double, corner: int)

let random = System.Random(20260918)

let corners =
    [(x = 0.0D, y = 0.0D),
     (x = 1.0D, y = 0.0D),
     (x = 0.5D, y = System.Math.sqrt(3.0D) / 2.0D)]

let image = IMAGE(640, 560)

toward_a_corner(at: Step) -> STREAM[Step, Step] =>
    (let chosen = random.next(corners.count)
     let corner = corners[chosen]

     let next =
         (x = (at.x + corner.x) / 2.0D,
          y = (at.y + corner.y) / 2.0D,
          corner = chosen)

     next || next)

plot(at: Step) is
    let spot = image.to_pixel(at.x, at.y)

    image.colour(COLOUR_MAP.hue(cast double(at.corner) / 3.0D))
    image.blend(cast int(spot.x), cast int(spot.y), 0.6D)
si

let start =
    (x = 0.3D + random.next_double() * 0.4D,
     y = 0.1D + random.next_double() * 0.3D,
     corner = 0)

image.view(-0.03D, -0.03D, 1.03D, 0.90D)

stream(start, toward_a_corner)
    |> skip(20)
    |> take(150000)
    |> each(plot)

image.write("chaos.png")

image.show("chaos.png")
